sources.title: Kronos Small — TSFM.ai
sources.snippet: Kronos Small is the mid-size checkpoint in the NeoQuasar Kronos family, sitting between the lightweight Mini variant and the higher-capacity Base model. It is the natural step up when Kronos Mini leaves accuracy on the table but the full Base checkpoint is more than a workload needs.
